name: ztensor
title: ztensor · anonymous subnets with Zuma consensus, on any chain
description: A zk approach to Bittensor-style subnets on ANY chain with an adapter: miners and validators are public SETS, but every action is a scope-linkable ring signature (LSAG over the STARK curve) made once by a Cairo prover and verified on-chain by each network's own contract — Starknet (Cairo), NEAR (Rust/wasm), Ethereum (Solidity/Yul), Solana (sBPF, in compute units), Substrate (ink! on pallet-contracts, in weight). Emission is split by Zuma consensus on chain: each tag’s consensus is the highest score half the validator set gave it, every score is clipped to it. A validator scores a miner's per-epoch tag without knowing which miner it is; a miner is scored without knowing which validator scored it.

protocol.scheme: LSAG (Liu-Wei-Wong) over the STARK curve, Poseidon challenges, key image I = x * Hp(scope)
protocol.miner_tag: key image under scope H('zuma-mine', subnet, epoch): one submission per miner per epoch, unlinkable across epochs
protocol.validator_nullifier: key image under scope H('zuma-score', subnet, epoch, tag): one score per validator per tag, unlinkable across tags
protocol.claim: after every tag of the epoch is settled, the miner re-signs in the epoch scope (same image = same tag) and credits emission * R_tag / sum R to any recipient
protocol.anonymity_set: min_ring (on-chain) <= ring <= the adapter max_ring: 64 Starknet, 32 NEAR (300 Tgas), 32 Ethereum (EIP-7825), 32 Solana (session layout), 64 Substrate (weight: ~5.7 ms/member of a 1.3 s extrinsic); strictly sorted key ids so rings cannot be padded
protocol.relayer: contract never checks the caller; actions are posted by a relayer account because the tx sender is public
protocol.contract: src/networks/<chain>/contract/ per chain (starknet: Scarb+snforge, near: near-sdk 5 crate, eth: Foundry, solana: sBPF crate, substrate: ink! 5 crate via cargo-contract 5.0.3 on rust 1.88); each chain = one adapter package, see src/networks/README.md
protocol.prover: src/core/prover/ (Cairo program linking the starknet contract's lsag module; scarb cairo-run) — the one signer every chain verifies
protocol.yuma: settle(epoch, tag), anyone after the epoch: kappa 1/2, every validator weighs 1 (V snapshotted at the epoch's first submit, non-voters = 0); consensus C = max s with #{score >= s} >= ceil(V/2); rank R = sum min(score, C); reference src/core/yuma.py

toolchain.rust: stable + wasm32-unknown-unknown, RUSTFLAGS -C target-cpu=mvp --cfg near, then tools/wasmlower
toolchain.ink: cargo-contract 5.0.3 on rust 1.88.0 (+rust-src, clippy); substrate-contracts-node v0.42.0 in ~/.local/bin

networks.devnet: starknet: local starknet-devnet on :51332 (seed 0; owner/relayer/payee accounts)
networks.sepolia: starknet: sncast account (STRK-funded) via account=, rpc= or ZTENSOR_RPC_SEPOLIA
networks.mainnet: starknet: sncast account (STRK-funded) via account=, rpc= or ZTENSOR_RPC_MAINNET
networks.near: local near-sandbox on :51333 (root test.near; relayer/payee sub-accounts)
networks.near-testnet: NEAR testnet via the near module keystore (~/.mod/near/keys.json), account=
networks.substrate: substrate: local substrate-contracts-node --dev on :51337 (//Alice owner, //Bob relayer, //Charlie payee; one block per extrinsic)
networks.substrate-testnet: substrate: any pallet-contracts chain via ZTENSOR_SUBSTRATE_RPC + ZTENSOR_SUBSTRATE_SEED; USD priced on Astar mainnet
networks.postquant: own postquant node on :51336 (orbit/postquant src/api.py, chain ztensor-pq, data/postquant/; wallets relayer + payee); pqc1 wasm contract run off chain, ML-DSA receipts
networks.postquant-1: any postquant node: ZTENSOR_PQ_URL (default :51030) + ZTENSOR_PQ_TOKEN + ZTENSOR_PQ_WALLET

state: data/ next to config.json: keys.json (0600, member secrets, never leave the box), deployments.json, per-chain local state — all gitignored
console: src/static/index.html served by src/server.py: chain switch built from GET networks (a new adapter appears on its own), LIVE ring stage + run/replay an anonymous epoch on any chain, CODE (every chain's verifier, side by side), COSTS, TESTS, WHITEPAPER. Reads + sandbox simulate are public; anything touching member keys is loopback-only.

layout.src/mod.py: module fns, chain-agnostic: resolves network= to an adapter
layout.src/networks/base.py: the Network contract every chain adapter implements
layout.src/networks/<chain>/: adapter.py + client.py + contract/ + tools/ + tests/ (starknet, near, eth, solana, substrate, postquant; _template to add one)
layout.pytest.ini: offline by default; ZTENSOR_NATIVE=1 native suites; ZTENSOR_LIVE=1 full epochs
